rows.label: qst501805_msg0001
rows.name:
I'm supposed to give the Tome of Mors
to some strange Blade, mo...

rows.label: qst501805_msg0002
rows.name: Are you the messenger, mo?

rows.label: qst501805_msg0003
rows.name:
Nice to meet you. I'm Krezzi Temtem,
mo.

rows.label: qst501805_msg0004
qst501805_msg0005
rows.name:
I wrote this in the letter too, but I
won't give the Tome of Mors away for
free, mo.

rows.label: qst501805_msg0006
rows.name:
The condition is an item good enough
to satisfy Krezzi, Luxuria's eccentric
collector, mo.

rows.label: qst501805_msg0007
rows.name:
Krezzi measures unusual items with
an Excitement Index, mo.

rows.label: qst501805_msg0008
rows.name:
What Krezzi wants most now is
something that makes Krezzi's heart
race with excitement, mo!!

rows.label: qst501805_msg0009
rows.name:
So I'll trade it for an item with an
Excitement Index over 100, mo!

rows.label: qst501805_msg0010
rows.name:
Did you bring an item with an
Excitement Index over 100, mo?

rows.label: qst501805_msg0011
rows.name:
Krezzi has discerning eyes, so it
takes a lot to excite Krezzi, mo.

rows.label: qst501805_msg0012
rows.name: Haa... This won't do at all, mo...

rows.label: qst501805_msg0013
rows.name:
To make Krezzi's heart race, you need
an even more outrageous idea, mo.

rows.label: qst501805_msg0014
rows.name: Th-this is eccentric, mo!

rows.label: qst501805_msg0015
rows.name:
Amazing, mo! I can't believe that
combination created such an impactful
work of art!

rows.label: qst501805_msg0016
rows.name: Haa... My heart really raced, mo.

rows.label: qst501805_msg0017
rows.name:
I'll put it beside the fireplace at
home right away and invite everyone
over to admire it, mo.

rows.label: qst501805_msg0018
rows.name:
Then, as promised, I'll give you the
Tome of Mors, mo.

rows.label: qst501805_msg0019
rows.name:
Krezzi planned to collect them too,
but that strange Blade already has
volumes two through four, mo.

rows.label: qst501805_msg0020
rows.name:
I hope the Blade works hard to
decipher them for Krezzi too, mo!
